name: stayeasy-monorepo
description: StayEasy - Trusted accommodation discovery and booking platform for students & working professionals

scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "DB,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run db" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "DB,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run db" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client

author: StayEasy Team
